meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: Claude 会扫描项目里未被使用的代码,经 LSP 引用查询逐个确认后,分批交给并行子代理删除,每批跑类型检查并单独提交一次 commit,最后给出删除与跳过的汇总表。
howto.when: 当你提到「remove dead code」「dead code」「cleanup」等关键词,或要求清理项目里的无用代码时触发。不给参数就扫描整个项目,也可限定到某个文件或目录。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目里的无用代码清理掉
say.note: 扫描确认后分批删除并各自提交

say.text: 只清理 src/tools/baz 目录下的死代码
say.note: 把扫描范围限定到该目录

say.text: 查一下 unusedFunc 这个符号现在还有没有人引用

howto.what_en: Claude scans the project for unused code, confirms each candidate with LSP reference lookups, then deletes them in parallel batches, typechecking and committing each batch separately, and reports a summary.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "remove dead code", "dead code", "cleanup", or ask to clean up unused code. Without arguments it scans the whole project; you can limit it to a file or directory.

say_en.text: Clean up the unused code in this project.
say_en.note: Scans, verifies, then removes in batches and commits

say_en.text: Only clean up dead code under src/tools/baz.
say_en.note: Limits the scan to that directory

say_en.text: Check whether the symbol unusedFunc is still used anywhere.
say_en.note: Scopes the check to that symbol
